title: Sleep needs the newest BIOS
line: If sleep doesn't work or the controller is gone after waking, update the BIOS from AYANEO's site first.
symptom: Sleep is unreliable on AYANEO handhelds with an old BIOS, and the controller can be lost after waking.
why: Fixed by AYANEO in BIOS updates, not by the system.
undo: Nothing to undo: this is advice, GameCove changes nothing.
bazzite: Not a system matter: Bazzite's AYANEO page asks for the newest BIOS.

probe.what: Bazzite's page names no BIOS versions, so nothing on the device can tell.
